sample_unit: participants (20 lab pilot users, 21 osteoarthritis patients, 7 healthcare professionals)
unlisted_practices: Connecting an LLM-driven social robot to whitelisted validated clinical sources for answering patient questions
End-user engagement using the User Experience Questionnaire and semi-structured interviews to assess acceptability

screen.reason: The study tests the feasibility and user experience of a GPT-powered social robot communicating with osteoarthritis patients and healthcare professionals in clinical practice, but does not compare or evaluate a specific organizational deployment safeguard/practice.
